name: tampermonkey-zenn-hide-github-card-stats
description: A Tampermonkey script that hides the star count and fork count on GitHub repository cards embedded in Zenn articles

scripts.lint: bun run eslint ; bun run prettier
scripts.prettier: prettier zenn-hide-github-card-stats.user.js > /dev/null && echo 'Prettier: No issues found' || echo 'Prettier: Issues found'
scripts.fix: bun run eslint:fix && bun run prettier:fix
